submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE (0.200%) at Co0.45Sb0.55, which sits in the single-phase rutile-type region. EQE fell off on both sides: 0.062% at Co0.62 (index 11) and 0.0056% at Co0.33 (index 20, where XRD shows a secondary Sb-oxide phase). This suggests the peak is near index 16, somewhere between index 11 and the region where the second phase starts.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE was only 0.0056%. This is the CoSb2O6 stoichiometry, but XRD shows extra peaks (2.44, 2.70, 3.64 1/A), which point to a secondary Sb-oxide phase.
Measured EQE was 0.062%, lower than index 16.
XRD shows strong peaks from an Sb-rich second phase, and EQE was already falling toward the Sb-rich end.
